calls.thesis: Onto Innovation: price fallen just below bottom rung of signal ladder — no buying until full re-review, which it passes (record sales +35%, backlog >$1B first time, PEG ~0.6, profits expected +44% next year). Condition: let early-November earnings pass first, then keep small and DCA on the way down. First tracked BWB call on ONTO.
calls.base_case: Forecasts raised ~18% since July (10 raises, 0 cuts in last month) while stock -26% since July.
calls.bull_case: Advanced packaging inspection segment expected +80% this year; new long-term targets due Dec 17.
calls.bear_case: Big memory-maker exposure; Chinese memory design news hit the group; a >$200M order rests on a single customer; swings ~3x market.
